## NYT::NFlow::TUnitedParameters&lt;NYT::NFlow::TKafkaSink&gt; {#NYT_NFlow_TUnitedParameters_NYT_NFlow_TKafkaSink}

Source: [yt/yt/flow/library/cpp/common/registry-inl.h]({{source-root}}/yt/yt/flow/library/cpp/common/registry-inl.h)

#|
|| **Parameter** | **Description** ||
|| `topic` | **Type**: `std::string`
**Required parameter**
Name of the Kafka topic. ||
|| `payload_column` | **Type**: `std::string`
**Default value**: `data`
Input column whose bytes become the record value. A null value is written as a Kafka null value, which is a tombstone in a compacted topic. ||
|| `key_column` | **Type**: `std::string`
**Default value**: `TString("")`
Input column whose bytes become the record key; librdkafka chooses the partition by the key. An empty name or a null value means no key, and librdkafka spreads such records across partitions. ||
|| `message_id_header` | **Type**: `std::string`
**Default value**: `TString("")`
Name of a record header carrying the Flow message ID. The ID is preserved when the asynchronous sink replays a message, but may change on recomputation for the synchronous sink. An empty string disables the header. ||
|| `delivery_guarantee` | **Type**: [NYT::NFlow::EKafkaDeliveryGuarantee](./all_yson_structs#NYT_NFlow_EKafkaDeliveryGuarantee)
**Default value**: `exactly_once`
What the sink guarantees for the messages a restart replays; see `NYT::NFlow::EKafkaDeliveryGuarantee`. Changing it requires stopping the pipeline. ||
|| `transactional_id_prefix` | **Type**: `std::string`
**Default value**: `flow-`
With `exactly_once`, the transactional ID of each sink partition is this prefix followed by its producer ID, which is persisted in the sink state. A consumer group with the same name keeps the progress marker of the partition as its offset on partition 0 of the topic. Grant the principal access to the transactional IDs and consumer groups with this prefix. Change it only while the pipeline is stopped. ||
|| `transaction_timeout` | **Type**: [TDuration](./all_yson_structs#TDuration)
**Default value**: `1m`
With `exactly_once`, librdkafka `transaction.timeout.ms`: the broker aborts a transaction open for longer. It must be at least one second and at most the broker's `transaction.max.timeout.ms`. ||
|#


{% cut "**Additional parameters**" %}


#|
|| `max_transaction_record_count` | **Type**: `long`
**Default value**: `10000`
With `exactly_once`, the maximum number of records one transaction writes. ||
|| `max_transaction_byte_size` | **Type**: `long`
**Default value**: `16777216`
With `exactly_once`, the maximum total size of the keys, values, and message IDs one transaction writes. A transaction always takes at least one record. ||
|#
